title: gaya lyallii
intro: Gaya lyallii, commonly known as the silver ragwort, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Gaya lyallii include its analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of Gaya lyallii are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been used to treat various health conditions.
